children: Thailand's 2H GDP growth is likely to remain around the same pace as 1H, says Bank of Thailand's Piti Disyatat in an interview. The economy has held up quite well despite the global oil shock, posting 1H growth of around 2.4%, he adds. "It's not a high number, but [it's] relative to what we had expected," says the deputy governor for monetary stability. The BOT will factor in recent floods that hit Thailand in its upcoming growth forecast, but Piti expects "minimum impact for the whole economy." There are some disruptions across the country, but the duration of the flooding was short, he notes.(amanda.lee@wsj.com)
